ArmoryStoreSpec.summary: Makes a storage building keep arms only (troop weapons and gear, siege and ship ammunition) and turns away everything else.

BanditCampSpec.summary: Makes the building a bandit camp: it spawns its bandits when a game starts, its loot can't be taken and its fire burns until they're all dead.

fields.BanditCount: How many bandits the camp starts with. Stronger camps are better armed.

BanditLadderSpec.summary: Marks a ladder as one bandits put up on a raid: it's climbed from its own tile and taken down afterwards. Use it together with SiegeLadderSpec.

BarracksSpec.summary: Makes the building train troops. With no field set it trains swordsmen, spearmen and the like.

fields.Ranged: Trains archers and other shooters instead (an archery range). Default false.
fields.Muster: Trains militia and scouts from plain logs and berries. Default false.

BatteringRamSpec.summary: Makes the building a battering ram that a crew swings at walls, gates, towers, siege engines and dams. Its damage and speed come from the troop stats file.

fields.CrewRange: No longer used. Accepted so older blueprints still load.

BoatEngineSpec.summary: Gives a ship a steam engine that burns logs and water from its hold while it sails, for a faster crossing.

fields.LogsPerHour: Logs burnt per hour while the ship is under way. Default 0.03.
fields.WaterPerHour: Water used per hour while under way. Default 0.1.
fields.SpeedBoost: How many times as fast the ship sails with the engine running. Default 1.5. Without logs or water it falls back to its crew's rowing.

BoatSpec.summary: Makes the template a ship: it sails, carries a crew and can only be placed on a Naval Workshop slip.

fields.TilesPerHour: Speed with no wind, in tiles per hour. Default 50.
fields.WindTilesPerHour: Speed in the strongest wind, in tiles per hour. Weaker wind falls in between. Left out or 0, wind makes no difference.
fields.TurnDegreesPerHour: Turning speed with no wind, in degrees per hour. Left out or 0, the ship turns on the spot.
fields.WindTurnDegreesPerHour: Turning speed in the strongest wind, in degrees per hour. Left out or 0, wind makes no difference to turning.
fields.Draft: How deep the hull sits in the water at sea, in tiles. Default 0.6.

CastleUpgradeSpec.summary: Lets a District Center be upgraded in place to a castle, paid in science and goods and built by its builders.

fields.ScienceCost: Science its owner pays when the upgrade starts.
fields.Cost: Goods builders bring in, as a list of {"Id", "Amount"}.
fields.WorkHours: Hours of building work the upgrade takes.
fields.Model: The castle model shown in place of the District Center.
fields.Scaffold: The scaffold model shown over it while it's built.

CombatLockSpec.summary: Controls whether the building can be placed or demolished beside enemy fighters.

fields.AllowNearEnemies: Lets the building go up with enemies close by. Without it, it can't. Default false.

FieldInfirmarySpec.summary: Makes the building a field infirmary: a wheeled healing tub where badly hurt troops lie out of the fight and heal much faster than with a herbalist. Healing uses up extract and berries. Its numbers are in the troop stats file.

HordeOnlySpec.summary: Puts the building in the toolbar of Horde games only.

LandClaimSpec.summary: Claims the land in a circle around the building for its owner, so other players can't build there. Where enemy claims overlap, each tile goes to the nearer one.

fields.Radius: Radius of the claim, in tiles.

LookoutSpec.summary: Makes the building see further through the fog of war, further still from high ground.

fields.Sight: How far it sees, in tiles.

MineLauncherSpec.summary: Makes the building release water mines, or explosive boats, from its panel button or its automation input. Each release takes a worker and water to launch into.

fields.LaunchCoordinates: Where the mine or boat enters the water, in the building's own tiles ({X, Y, Z}).
fields.Boats: Sends out explosive boats instead of mines. Default false.
fields.LaunchCost: Goods each mine or boat uses up, as a list of {"Id", "Amount"}.
fields.StoredLaunches: How many launches' worth of goods it keeps in store.

MineNetSpec.summary: Makes the building a floating boom with a net that catches drifting mines until it's full. Chain several in a line to make a wall.

fields.Capacity: Mines one segment holds before it's full.

MineNetWinchSpec.summary: Makes the building a winch on the bank that, while it has a worker, hauls in the catch of the nets chained to it and takes the mines apart into explosives.

MoltenMetalSpec.summary: Makes the building's glowing metal and fire parts flow and glow orange. Looks only.

MooredMineSpec.summary: Marks a spot in the water where a mine slipway anchors a mine. It sits still and goes off when a boat or a drifting mine comes close, or in another blast.

NavalWorkshopSpec.summary: Makes the building a shipyard: it stands on the shore with a slip running out into the shallows, and ships can only be placed on that slip. The slip's first row along (SlipY - 1) is the shed, which a ship's bow sits against.

fields.SlipX: Where the slip starts across the building, in the building's own tiles.
fields.SlipY: Where the slip starts along the building, in tiles.

NeedsSandSpec.summary: Makes the building work only when standing on sand. Anywhere else its beavers don't come and a status says so.

PalisadeGateSpec.summary: Makes the building a gate with open, closed and automated modes. Auto open lets its own side through and shuts when enemies come near.

fields.Passage: Where the way through is, in the building's own tiles ({X, Y, Z}), for gates bigger than their passage.
fields.Bridge: A drawbridge's tiles out from the passage, as a list of {X, Y, Z}. They're walkable only while the gate is open.

PirateBoatSpec.summary: Marks a boat as a bandit camp's: it belongs to the bandits and the camp it came from, and sails under black sails.

ResinIgniterSpec.summary: Makes the building a detonator for resin: built on a resin puddle, it sets the puddle alight when its input turns on, and takes another pulse for the next puddle laid there.

ResinPuddleSpec.summary: Makes the building a puddle of resin that burns when lit, hurts everyone standing in it and spreads to touching puddles.

fields.BurnHours: How long it burns once lit, in hours.
fields.DamagePerHour: Damage per hour to everyone standing in it.
fields.ZombieFactor: How many times as many of the Horde's zombies it burns, on each of its tiles, as its damage alone would kill.
fields.CatchHours: Hours from the fire arrow landing to the flames taking hold.
fields.SpreadHours: Hours after it starts burning before touching puddles catch.
fields.Flames: Names of the flame effects shown over it while it burns.

RoundTowerSpec.summary: Makes the building a round tower: open on top, with room for one catapult, ballista or trebuchet, which stands guard there on its own. A wall joins it at the middle of a side.

ShipArmamentSpec.summary: Gives a ship gun ports where cannons can be mounted.

fields.Ports: The gun ports, as a list of {"Side", "Position"}. Side is -1 for the side towards X = 0 and 1 for the other. Position is the port's middle in the model's frame.
fields.PortArc: How far round the ports let a gun turn, as a share of the gun's own arc. Default 1. Round ports in an iron hull hold it close, so use less; guns on an open deck swing freely.
fields.Hull: Where the hull lies in its footprint, as {X, Y, Width, Length}, in tiles with Y counted from the bow. The panel uses it to place the ports over the deck drawing.
fields.DeckSprite: The deck drawing the panel puts the ports over, bow to the left. Left out, it's Sprites/TimberEmpires/Ships/TemplateNameDeck.

ShipCrewModeSpec.summary: Lets a ship's crew be civil (workers sail it) or military (troops aboard sail it and fire its guns). It can only be switched while the ship is ashore.

fields.Military: Starts the ship with a military crew. Default false.

ShipHoldSpec.summary: Gives a ship a hold that haulers load and unload like a warehouse, and that slows the ship as it fills.

fields.Slots: How many kinds of goods it can be set to load at once. Default 5.
fields.Capacity: The most it holds, all goods together. Default 100.
fields.LoadedSpeed: The share of its speed it keeps with the hold full, less loaded in between. Default 0.6.
fields.LoadedTurn: The share of its turning it keeps with the hold full. Default 0.4.

SiegeEngineSpec.summary: Makes the building a siege engine that fires at enemies in reach. Its range, reload and damage come from the troop stats file; the blueprint sets how it moves and looks.

fields.FacingOffset: Which way the model faces when placed unturned, in degrees from the game's +y. 0 for a trebuchet, 180 for wheeled engines.
fields.ArmPivot: Where the throwing arm pivots, in the building's own space ({X, Y, Z}).
fields.ArmLength: Arm length above the pivot, in tiles. 0 means no arm, as on a ballista.
fields.CockedAngle: The arm's angle when cocked, in degrees.
fields.ThrownAngle: The arm's angle after the throw, in degrees.
fields.RestAngle: The arm's angle at rest, in degrees.
fields.SlingLength: Length of the sling hanging from the arm's tip, in tiles. 0 for none.
fields.FlatShot: Shoots flat like a ballista bolt instead of lobbing. Default false.
fields.Stream: Makes it a flamethrower: no shots, a stream of fire kept up while it has a target and fuel. Default false.
fields.Muzzle: For a flamethrower, where the middle of its nozzle pair is, in the building's own space ({X, Y, Z}).
fields.MuzzleSpread: For a flamethrower, how far apart the nozzles are, in tiles.

SiegeLadderSpec.summary: Makes the building a ladder that warriors and carters climb on their own. It adds nothing to the navmesh and isn't a road.

fields.Rise: How many levels it climbs: 1 for a ladder up a step, 2 for a siege tower up onto a wall's walkway.

SiegeMoverSpec.summary: Lets a siege engine be built at home and pushed to where it's needed by its crew, a tile at a time. It goes round obstacles but never up or down a level. Its speed comes from the troop stats file.

fields.CrewRange: No longer used. Accepted so older blueprints still load.

SiegeRampSpec.summary: Makes the building a ramp two tiles deep up a one level step: the way up and down for siege machines, and a road like stairs for everyone on foot.

StartingGoodsSpec.summary: Lets a map give a starting location goods of its own, picked in the map editor, which the settlement there gets in its District Center besides the game's starting goods.

fields.Slots: How many kinds of goods it can hold. Default 8.
fields.Capacity: How much it holds, all goods together. Default 1000.

StructureHealthSpec.summary: Gives the building health that attacks wear down. Walls, gates, towers and siege engines get theirs from the troop stats file, other buildings by size.

fields.Machine: Marks it as a machine troops ride (a boat) rather than something built to keep them out. Default false.

TradePostSpec.summary: Makes the building a trade post on the shore with a pier out into the water. Ships beached by the pier trade there at the values its owner sets.

fields.LandRows: How many of its rows, counted from the back, stand on land. The rest is the pier out over the water. Default 2.
fields.Reach: How far from the pier's end a beached ship can be and still trade there, in tiles. Default 10.

TripWireSpec.summary: Makes the building one end of a trip wire: a zipline tower that takes a single wire to the other end of the pair, and sends an automation signal when someone crosses it. The player picks who trips it (enemies, allies, the owner's own, anybody).

TroopsCounterSpec.summary: Makes the building an automation sensor that counts troops. The player picks what it counts (total, ready, in training, at home, deployed, fighting or wounded).

WagonYardSpec.summary: Makes the building a wagon yard that builds supply carts for food, water and building materials.

fields.CartCapacity: How many goods a cart holds.

WallBrazierSpec.summary: Makes the building a fire bowl hung off a palisade piece that burns resin brought by haulers. Archers on the wall nearby light their arrows at it.

fields.Reach: How many wall pieces either way of the one it stands on an archer can stand and still light arrows at it.
fields.InjuryChance: Chance each fire arrow burns the archer loosing it, from 0 to 1.

WallDecorationSpec.summary: Makes the building a banner, totem or shield rack on a wall that makes the troops near it hit harder and take less damage. The area it helps is its RangedEffectBuildingSpec radius.

fields.Kind: Banner, Totem or ShieldRack. Only the strongest of each kind helps a troop at a time.
fields.Damage: How much harder the troops it helps hit, as a fraction (0.06 is 6%).
fields.Taken: How much less damage they take, as a fraction.
fields.Mounted: Hangs it on the wall's outer face instead of standing it on the walk. Default false.

WallDropSpec.summary: Makes the building a hoarding that drops its supply on enemies at the foot of the wall, one at a time.

fields.Mode: Roll rolls a log straight out from the wall, hitting everyone in its way. Pour splashes boiling oil at the foot of the wall.

WallSpec.summary: Makes the building a piece of a town wall.

fields.Kind: Palisade, Gatehouse, WallTower, Hoarding or WallFoundation.

WarBoatSpec.summary: Makes a ship a war boat that goes on a Shipyard's slip, takes troops aboard and fights. Its speed, crew, health and gun reach come from the troop stats file.

WarriorCrewSpec.summary: Lets troops ride inside the building and work it. A siege engine or boat needs its crew aboard.

fields.CrewAnimation: The animation the crew plays at their posts, one every beaver has.
fields.BoardsOverBow: Troops board from the shore it's against, bow first, instead of from behind. For a boat on a beach. Default false.

WatchtowerAlarmSpec.summary: Makes a watchtower an automation transmitter that is on while enemy troops or bandits stand on the land it watches. Only a lit tower keeps watch.

WreckedHullSpec.summary: Swaps the texture of a wreck's hull.

fields.Atlas: The atlas the model's Pine material is swapped for, a path in the mod. Default MapEditor/WreckedHull/WreckedHullAtlas.
